label.text: ${confirmation.changeCount} statements may change data. With changes the script is one transaction and stops at the first failure.
${confirmation.ownTransactionCount} of them (such as VACUUM or CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY) run on their own outside any transaction, so they are not rolled back.
